svg.title: Watch an ice front rise through a freezing water droplet
svg.desc: An original X-ray radiograph at 28 seconds shows liquid water above an advancing ice front and bubble-containing ice below. The source, beam paths and light-green detector around that measured image are schematic. Original radiograph: Im et al., arXiv:2511.20571v1, Fig. 1(e).

image.aria-label: Original X-ray radiograph: liquid above the ice front, frozen ice and bubbles below, at 28 seconds

g.text: Ice grows upward from the cooled substrate
